TheolderSuslymetadoleritedykeintheSuslyquarrycarriesa
verylimitedamountofzircongrains.ACLinvestigationrevealed
thepresenceofacorroded(inherited)coreinonezircon.Thiscore
yieldedaconcordantageof2095±5Ma,whiletheageofthewide
rimisdiscordantandhasa208Pb/232Thageof2080Ma.However,
both ages are higher than the age of the host rock and must be
regardedwithcaution.
The younger Susly metadolerite dyke carries a large number
of zircons that can be subdivided into three groups. The first
groupincludesprismaticslightlyresorbedbrowncrystalswithwell
developedpyramidaltips.Thecathodeluminescence(CL)israther
weakandrevealssomefuzzyzonality.Thesecondgroupincludes
greyprismaticcrystalswithheavilyresorbedtips.Oneofthegrains
differsbyitselongatedshape.CLimagesofcrystalsfromthissec-
ondgrouprevealweakluminescencewithconcentriczonalityand
inheritedcoresareabsent.Finally,thethirdgroupofgrainsconsists
ofratherfine(<100(cid:2)m)prismaticandisometriceuhedralcolour-
lesstransparentcrystalswithwelldevelopedpyramidaltips.InCL
imagescrystalsfromthisgroupdisplayconcentriczonality.Sixzir-
con grains that represent the three groups of zircons have been
analysed. Three of the zircons are almost concordant and their
weighted average age is 2105±7Ma. One of the zircons is very
discordantandfallsfarawayfromtheotherzirconsintheU–Pb
isotopicplotanditdeviatessignificantlyfromtheregressionline.
